title: Zesty Sweet Irish Sweets Crumble
description: A sweet and bouncy Irish dessert featuring sugar syrup and score-fat, friendly to sugar-free diets. This dish is perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the oats, score-fat, and sugar syrup until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the brown sugar, melted butter, eggs, vanilla extract, and cinnamon.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a crumbly mixture forms.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the crumble warm, topped with whipped cream or ice cream if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
